meta.title: Bedrock Construction Group — We Build What Lasts
meta.description: Bedrock Construction Group is a full-service general contractor delivering commercial, industrial, and infrastructure projects across the region since 1992.

hero.headline: Ground broken. Standards higher.
hero.subheadline: We deliver commercial, industrial, and infrastructure projects with the precision of an engineer and the grit of a crew that shows up before sunrise.

services.title: General Contracting
services.description: Single point of accountability from groundbreaking to final walkthrough, with self-performed structural and concrete crews.

services.title: Design-Build
services.description: One contract, one team. We collapse the gap between design and construction to cut cost and compress your schedule.

services.title: Commercial Construction
services.description: Offices, retail, hospitality, and mixed-use. Spaces engineered for the people who use them every day.

services.title: Industrial & Infrastructure
services.description: Warehouses, plants, bridges, and utilities built to carry load for decades, not warranty periods.

services.title: Renovation & Restoration
services.description: Adaptive reuse and historic restoration that respects what was built and reinforces it for what's next.

services.title: Pre-Construction
services.description: Estimating, value engineering, and constructability reviews that surface risk while it's still cheap to fix.

process.title: Consult
process.description: We sit down before anyone picks up a pencil. Budget, timeline, and risk get defined out loud.

process.title: Plan
process.description: Pre-construction modeling, estimating, and value engineering turn the vision into a buildable, costed plan.

process.title: Build
process.description: Self-performed crews and vetted subs execute against a schedule you can watch in real time.

process.title: Deliver
process.description: Punch list closed, warranties documented, keys handed over. Then we stay reachable.

about.headline: Three decades of showing up.
body: Bedrock started in 1992 with two pickup trucks, a concrete mixer, and a refusal to cut corners. Thirty-two years later the equipment yard is bigger, but the rule hasn't moved an inch.

We self-perform our structural, concrete, and carpentry work, which means the people accountable for your project are on our payroll, not a stranger's. That's how schedules hold and quality stays consistent from the footing to the final coat.

testimonials.quote: Bedrock hit a 14-month schedule on a project everyone else padded to 18. No drama, no change-order games. Just built.
testimonials.author: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: They walked us through every risk before we signed. When the unexpected showed up underground, they already had a plan.
testimonials.author: Marcus Reyes
